text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Friday.
- Displaced people will be voting at 77 polling stations in their current place of residence.
- Is Brcko to remain under Serb control for yet another year?
- Government sets Koncar electrical group share issue at 105 million marks to be offered in Croatia and abroad.
- We had to wage secret politics, says in an interview, explaining Croatia's policies during the war, president's chief-of-staff, Hrvoje Sarinic.

- The pilot-issue of a new current affairs magazine financed by USIA and having as its editor-in-chief, the renowned journalist of The Economist, Chris Cviic to be introduced in the next few days in Zagreb. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
